title: Scientific blog foundation and professional reading experience
why: Create a content-first scientific and technical blog with consistent navigation, rigorous figures and articles, accessible reading, discovery, and an honest interdisciplinary author profile.
done_when: All phases meet their acceptance criteria, publishing outputs exclude drafts, existing article links remain valid, and representative articles pass desktop/mobile, keyboard, theme, and scientific-content checks.
success_metrics: One shared topic vocabulary and consistent listing/navigation behavior across the site.
Representative articles support figures, math, collapsed contents, both themes, and useful failure behavior on mobile and desktop.
Search, RSS, related reading, and sitemap expose only eligible published content.
About communicates confirmed background and interests without fabricated expertise; no missing public asset links remain.
kill_conditions: Stop and revise an implementation that hides the writing behind a portfolio presentation or invents professional experience.
Re-scope if a feature requires infrastructure beyond static GitHub Pages without a demonstrated need.

phases.title: Project contract and structured planning
phases.useful_alone: Future work follows one documented direction and a compatible LifeOS ledger.
phases.done_when: Mirrored instruction files, architecture/editorial guidance, interest notes, and schema-valid ledger bundles exist and are readable by LifeOS.

items.text: Record the owner decisions, boundaries, and scientific editorial standard.

evidence.value: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md; docs/architecture.md; docs/editorial.md; .work/README.md; research/README.md. Ledger schema/reader validation is recorded in Working notes.

2026-10-20: all 7 ledger JSON data files passed vendored JSON Schema validation; LifeOS read/validate and next-item selection passed; JSON format, source provenance, 11 relative Markdown links, and identical CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md passed checks.

items.text: Adopt ledger v2, capture deferred ideas/proposals, and separate unpublished research interests.

evidence.value: CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md; docs/architecture.md; docs/editorial.md; .work/README.md; research/README.md. Ledger schema/reader validation is recorded in Working notes.

2026-10-20: all 7 ledger JSON data files passed vendored JSON Schema validation; LifeOS read/validate and next-item selection passed; JSON format, source provenance, 11 relative Markdown links, and identical CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md passed checks.

phases.title: Consistent topics and usable navigation
phases.useful_alone: Readers can understand topics and navigate on mobile without broken destinations.
phases.done_when: One topic registry drives schema and presentation; writing/topic pages share chrome; mobile and keyboard navigation work; missing asset links are resolved or hidden; existing article URLs remain valid.

items.text: Inspect current route/link behavior and settle the writing-led entry route and initial topic labels.

evidence.value: Retain / -> /blog as the writing-first entry and preserve category/article URLs. Use existing FraH90 identity, Writing/About navigation, and stable slug labels/order in src/lib/topics.ts. Redirect empty /projects to /blog; CV links depend on a real public PDF.

items.text: Introduce shared topic metadata and publication eligibility; replace duplicated category maps and inconsistent list/filter layouts.

evidence.value: src/lib/topics.ts is shared by the collection schema, topic filters, routes and article labels. src/lib/posts.ts owns draft eligibility. PostListing.astro shares archive/category layout.

items.text: Add clear site/home identity, accessible current-page state, and usable mobile navigation; remove empty destinations and conditionally hide missing CV links.

evidence.value: Chromium passed visible navigation, active state, keyboard skip/focus, and no page overflow at 320/390/768/1440px. Root and Projects aliases lead to Writing. CV links are absent without the PDF; presence/absence eligibility also passed an isolated temporary-directory check.

items.text: Resolve missing social preview assets and make card click targets match their interaction treatment.

evidence.value: public/og-default.png and editable public/branding/social-card.svg replace the missing preview target; Open Graph image URLs are absolute. Whole-card links passed non-title-area pointer and keyboard-focus checks.

items.text: Verify routes, draft exclusion, filters, link targets, narrow-screen layout, and keyboard navigation.

evidence.value: Final npm run build and npm run check:build passed (14 pages). Chromium checked writing, topic, About and an interactive article at 320/390/768/1440px, keyboard focus/skip, card targets, aliases and no-JS reading. A temporary draft fixture stayed out of routes/listings/topics/sitemap and was removed before the final build. The site remains dark; light mode belongs to Phase 2.

phases.title: Readable design and theme choice
phases.useful_alone: Articles and figures are comfortable to read in either theme.
phases.done_when: Dark is initial default; explicit light/dark choice persists without a flash; typography, contrast, figures, equations, code, and controls work across themes and screen sizes.

items.text: Create shared color/type/spacing/width tokens and harmonize site/list/article layouts.

evidence.value: src/styles/global.css provides semantic colors, readable prose/figure widths, theme-aware typography and syntax colors, local overflow, and focus styling. Layouts, cards, topics, About and demos now consume those tokens.

items.text: Implement an accessible persisted theme switch with early initialization and theme-aware scientific visualizations.

evidence.value: Chromium verified initial dark default regardless of system preference; explicit light/dark persistence across reload/navigation and cross-tab sync; saved light applied by the head script without the toggle module; invalid/blocked storage; keyboard toggle; chart font/trace changes with preserved zoom; labeled keyboard range inputs.

items.text: Check contrast, focus visibility, controls, long titles, prose widths, and figure/table/math overflow in both themes on mobile and desktop.

evidence.value: Final production build and check:build passed for 14 pages. Both themes passed responsive checks at 320/390/768/1440px across writing/topic/About and four live demos; axe contrast, label, button/link-name checks passed at 390/1440px. Temporary long-title/code/math/table/figure fixture passed localized keyboard scroll and width checks and was removed before final build. No-JS reading and plot-import error handling passed.

phases.title: Scientific article structure and authoring
phases.useful_alone: A real article can explain its purpose, assumptions, figures, and sources without layout workarounds.
phases.done_when: Article template supports learning statements, prerequisites, published date only, collapsed contents, scientific figures/captions/references, and linked supporting material; README matches real authoring paths.

items.text: Extend typed content metadata deliberately for learning statements/prerequisites and supported related material; keep publishing date display only.

evidence.value: Content schema adds optional learningGoals, prerequisites, assumptions, relatedPosts collection references, resources, and unique bibliographic references with empty defaults. Existing trial articles render without placeholders; the article header displays one publication date only.

items.text: Add heading anchors and collapsed-by-default contents with click/tap/keyboard operation and no permanent sidebar.

evidence.value: Native details/summary contents starts collapsed and uses Astro heading metadata. Chromium verified click/keyboard/no-JS navigation, focus transfer, repeated-heading IDs and progressive permalinks. Contents and heading targets remain static HTML without a sidebar.

items.text: Build reusable scientific figure/caption/reference patterns, accessible descriptions, and wide-figure behavior with provenance and units.

evidence.value: ScientificFigure supports source/type/caption/parameters, image alt/dimensions or accessible inline content, and optional wide layout. Citation and reference components provide stable source links. Duplicate reference keys fail schema validation; missing alt raised a specific rendering error; a broken citation fragment failed check:build.

items.text: Add related reading/project links using shared eligible-content rules and honest empty states.

evidence.value: Related reading prioritizes curated published entries and topic/tag overlaps, excludes self/duplicates/drafts, and omits empty panels. Fixture verified three published recommendations and hidden draft sentinel. Missing curated ID raised a specific authoring error. Supporting resources render only when provided.

items.text: Correct README architecture, imports, URLs, and publishing instructions.

evidence.value: README.md now describes actual routes, topic registry, draft eligibility, current MDX imports, CV behavior, deployment/build checks, and explicitly pending features. Completed during Phase 1.

items.text: Add a usable article starting template with the enhanced article metadata once that schema lands.

evidence.value: docs/templates/article.mdx and npm run new:post create typed, draft-first articles from the shared topic registry. CLI checks passed for creation, overwrite refusal, invalid path and unknown topic. docs/article-authoring.md documents metadata, figures, citations, related material and publishing checks.

items.text: Verify one representative article with math, figures, tables/code, prerequisites, contents, links, and both themes.

evidence.value: Fixture passed both themes at 320/390/768/1440px: math/code/table, goals/prerequisites/assumptions, contents/section focus, narrow/wide figures, captions/provenance, citations/references, related draft filtering, and selected axe rules. Final 14-page build/check:build and real articles at 390/1440px passed; fixtures were removed. No-JS contents/citations passed.

phases.title: Search and RSS
phases.useful_alone: Readers can find and follow published writing as the archive grows.
phases.done_when: Static search and RSS work for anonymous readers; draft fixtures never appear in search/feed/related content/sitemap; keyboard and mobile discovery are usable.

items.text: Compare static search approaches with a small index/payload/accuracy experiment before selecting a dependency.
Implement search with accessible opening, focus handling, keyboard controls, results, and no-results state; index only published content.
Generate RSS from published content with stable absolute URLs and discoverable feed links.
Check known queries, draft exclusion across every output, feed validity, and mobile/keyboard discovery.

phases.title: Reliable scientific demos
phases.useful_alone: Interactive articles remain informative when code is slow or unavailable.
phases.done_when: Demos provide loading/error/static alternatives, accessible controls, correct documented boundaries, plot cleanup, and measured loading behavior; normal article/list pages avoid unnecessary visualization payload.

items.text: Measure current visualization transfer/hydration cost and define a practical budget before selecting optimization work.
Add meaningful static alternatives and complete loading/error behavior around browser-only demos; verify fallback content and import failure beyond the existing chart error message.
Make plots and range controls theme-aware, preserve plot zoom, clean up plot/theme listeners, associate slider labels, and handle plot import/render rejection.

evidence.value: Completed during Phase 2: live charts render in development and production, change axis/trace colors, preserve a real drag-zoom, and still respond to keyboard slider input. Blocked plot import produced a readable error message without an unhandled page error. Full scientific/static fallbacks remain p5-2.

items.text: Correct and independently verify representative numerical/boundary behavior, including infinite VSWR and scientific statements that contradict the models.
Reduce unnecessary eager visualization loading or replace heavyweight plotting where the measured tradeoff justifies it.
Check offline/import failure, JavaScript disabled, keyboard controls, resize/theme behavior, boundary values, and measured payload against the agreed budget.

phases.title: Author context and publication readiness
phases.useful_alone: Readers can understand who writes the site and assess actual work.
phases.done_when: About uses owner-confirmed facts and working contact links; public trial content has an explicit disposition; at least one owner-approved article demonstrates the editorial/figure standard without invented evidence.

items.text: Gather confirmed background/public name and available work; write an honest interdisciplinary About page linked to relevant articles and contact.
Decide the disposition of each trial article and review any retained text and model assumptions before publication.
Prepare one real article with the owner using available scientific figures/data/code; distinguish tutorial, simulation, measurement, and exploration.
Run production build and review representative navigation, article, About, discovery, links, and failure states on desktop/mobile in both themes.

phases.title: Workflow permissions and automated deployment checks
phases.useful_alone: Broken public links and assets can stop deployment automatically instead of relying on a local check.
phases.done_when: Workflow-file edits are authorized through the integration, npm run check:build runs after the production build and before upload, and a successful workflow run verifies the gate.

items.text: Resolve the GitHub integration workflows permission using the supported LifeOS/GitHub configuration; do not add credentials to this repository.
Add npm run check:build after the Astro build and before GitHub Pages artifact upload; verify the check blocks broken output and a valid deployment passes.

open_questions: Public author/site display name and confirmed background for About.
Disposition of the five trial articles: correct and retain, replace, or retire.
